description: A first-person arena: pointer-locked look, WASD, hitscan fire, and infected that walk you down. The camera is the player; the enemies are real ScadRig characters.
highlights: Pointer-locked yaw/pitch look, camera driven by OnOverrideCamera
Hitscan fire with tracers, an enemy pool, health, ammo and reload
ScadRig infected: pools declared at scene build, clips played per state
